title: Binary Search
description:
Write a function `binary_search(arr, target)` that performs binary search on a **sorted** list.

Return the index of `target` if found, otherwise return `-1`.

You must implement the algorithm — do not use `list.index()` or the `bisect` module.
hint: Maintain left and right pointers. Compare the middle element with target and narrow the range.
outputExplanation: Binary search halves the search space each step, giving O(log n) time complexity.
